basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 2.' and it opens '| Vers. 2. Vade et proficiscere. Alia translatio habet fuge. Ex quo intelligimus ipsum'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: | Vers. 2. Vade et proficiscere. Alia translatio habet fuge. Ex quo intelligimus ipsum quoque per spiritum minas fratris cognovisse.
